title: Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Straw Guava / Dragon Berries Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: This dual pack delivers two complementary fruit blends. Straw’ Guava pairs sweet Strawberry with creamy Guava for a soft, rounded profile, while Dragon Berries mixes Dragonfruit with red berries for a brighter, more vivid finish. Designed for use with the Hayati Ultra 25K Prefilled Pod Kit, the pack combines a 2ml prefilled pod with two 10ml auto-refilling containers so you can load both refills together and switch on the device whenever you want a change. The click-fit design keeps setup quick, tidy and low maintenance. A mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid ensure smooth MTL vapour, clear flavour delivery and swift nicotine satisfaction from either refill. Explore all flavours: View the complete range How to Set Up Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Pods Step 1 Remove all protective seals from the 2ml pod and both 10ml refill containers. Step 2 Click the 2ml pod into the mouthpiece module. Step 3 Align and click up to two 10ml auto-refilling containers into the mouthpiece. Step 4 Insert the assembled unit into the device. Step 5 Allow a short moment for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set!
